response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with a strong web/full-stack background, but the profile does not match the core requirements of this embedded networking security role. There is no native-level Japanese (a hard requirement), no evidence of Linux kernel analysis or source modification, no LAN-switch, L2/L3 networking, MACsec/802.1X, or chip-vendor SDK experience, and C is only a small, decade-old portion of their work (National Instruments, 2014-2015). The bulk of recent experience is TypeScript/Node.js product and platform work, which is orthogonal to embedded firmware development.
strengths: 15+ years of broad software engineering experience, well beyond the 3+ year minimum
Prior C/C++ systems work at National Instruments and Linux/audio-server projects
Strong engineering discipline: TDD, CI/CD, test tooling, and open-source ownership
concerns: No Japanese language ability listed; role requires native-level proficiency
No Linux kernel, embedded firmware, or network switch/security domain experience
Recent decade is web/cloud focused; C skills are dated and not listed among core skills
